title: Languages
subtitle: Manage content languages
selectLanguageHelper: You can select a language from the list or edit directly below.
name: Language Name
nameHelper: The name displayed on your website (e.g. English).
localeHelper: Locale code for the language (e.g. vi).
codeHelper: Language code — preferably ISO 639-1 2-letter code (e.g. vi).
flagHelper: Choose a flag for the language.
orderHelper: Position of the language in the language switcher.
rtlHelper: Choose the text direction for the language.
setDefaultConfirm: Set "{name}" as default language? This will affect how content is served when no language is specified.
deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"? This will also delete all items in this language and cannot be undone!
defaultWarning: You should set the default language only once during the initial setup and avoid changing it later.
defaultWarningDetails: Changing the default language does not automatically update your existing content — all previously entered data remains tied to the original default language.
defaultWarningAction: If you decide to change the default language, you will need to manually update your site content to match the new default language, as it won't be updated automatically.
cannotDeleteLast: Cannot delete the last remaining language
noLanguagesSubtitle: Add your first language to get started
